verdict.rationale: vLLM is an inference and serving engine, and some such engines could act as an MCP client, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions MCP or connecting to external tool servers. The documented tool calling only parses model-generated function calls through the chat completion API; the calling application still has to execute the tools, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
